data.name: Boston Harbor Sunset Cruise
data.headline: All Ages! • 1.5 Hours •  Amazing views • Escape the hustle and bustle!
data.description: There is something about getting away from the hustle and bustle of the city life and watching the sunset from Boston Harbor. Mass Bay Lines provides a sensational Boston Harbor sunset cruise that truly have taken the breath away from so many local residents and visiting tourists. Enjoy the fresh air and escape the heat, see amazing views of Boston’s beautiful skyline and the historic USS Constitution as the sun sets behind the city. Our 90-minute sunset cruise will highlight popular and famous scenes of Boston Harbor from both past and present
